svg.text: Quiet Year → Builder → Open Source Contributor
real dates · mock layout · illustrated polaroid variant

g.text: first public repo, 2024-09 — the floor this whole story climbs from.
You showed up 241 days in 3 years.
124 pull requests opened, 106 merged — 23 in someone else’s repo.
2026-01 Distributed_MES · first external PR, and it merged

svg.text: — the numbers behind the story above
Peaks Jul '25 and Aug '26, both above 170.
Own PRs from Jul '25; ext PRs from Jan '26.
2025 study cluster; Aug '26 biggest birth month.
REVIEWS + ISSUES (too sparse for a line)
2 issues, 3 reviews — not enough points to call a trend.
★ is the high mark in that column. 2025 birthed the most repos (14). 2026 took the rest.
2024 is the floor, not a failure. 10 → 101 commit days is the whole story starting.

text.tspan: Contributions exist only in Jul and Q4 (10 commit days). One repo: the profile README.
Zero PRs, reviews, stars — the floor of every chart.
Repos spawn Feb–Aug. Commit days and own PRs explode in Jul–Sep on hanghae-plus.
Then a dead Q4 (2–3 contribs a month). Still no external PRs and no stars.
Jan: 173 contribs and the first external PR wave (MES). Jun own-PR spike (plc-app).
Jul quiet, then Aug is the max month: 214 contribs, readme-tool PRs, 5 repos, and the star cluster.
